title: Shattered Bubble Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a young woman with long dark hair and purple eyes, her face fracturing like broken porcelain or glass. She is enclosed within a large transparent bubble filled with floating musical notes, symbols, and smaller bubbles, set against a dark purple cosmic background with light beams from above.
